# Reinvention Works

> Reinvention Works™ provides peer-led education for adults rebuilding identity after disability, illness, or a health disruption, and for the organizations that support them. It is education, not therapy, medical care, or crisis support. Founder and Lead Facilitator: Shay Edmonds (he/him), a former 911 emergency communications engineer who lost his sight to Anti-MOG antibody disease and rebuilt his identity, career and independence. Operated by Evocut Dynamics LLC (Colorado, USA).

Key facts:
- Free starting point: Your First Move, a free guide with three short tools (the Story Separator, the Energy Snapshot and One True Thing), about 15 minutes in total.
- Core program: the 3-Day Reinvention Reset™, three consecutive live sessions on Zoom. Founding seats are free for the first 60 eligible people (upcoming cohorts November 10–12, 2026, 12:00–2:00 p.m. Central / 1:00–3:00 p.m. Eastern, and November 17–19 and December 1–3, 2026, 6:00–8:00 p.m. Central / 7:00–9:00 p.m. Eastern); partner organizations can also refer people or sponsor seats.
- Graduate Community: ongoing peer support for Reset graduates.
- Individual 1:1 coaching with Shay starts with a free 15-minute discovery call. Group Reinvention Coaching Calls are coming soon.
- Organizations can book a 30-minute partner discovery call or refer a client.

## Start here
- [Your First Move](https://reinvention-works-website.netlify.app/first-move/): The free guide and what's inside it.
- [3-Day Reinvention Reset™](https://reinvention-works-website.netlify.app/reset/): What the Reset is, the three sessions (what's true now, the energy you actually have, a next step that fits), and how to claim a free founding seat.
- [Programs](https://reinvention-works-website.netlify.app/programs/): The Reinvention Reset™ System: Your First Move, the 3-Day Reinvention Reset™, Graduate Community, and Reinvention Coaching Calls (coming soon).
- [Discovery call](https://reinvention-works-website.netlify.app/discovery-call/): A free call with Shay for individuals, or a partner call for organizations.

## For organizations
- [For Organizations](https://reinvention-works-website.netlify.app/organizations/): How healthcare providers, vocational rehabilitation and independent living teams, and employers make Reinvention Works available as a resource.
- [Referral and partnership](https://reinvention-works-website.netlify.app/referral-partnership/): Refer a client, sponsor Reset seats, or explore a partnership.
- [Speaking and Training](https://reinvention-works-website.netlify.app/speaking/): Keynotes, workshops and organizational training, with five speaking topics.
